name: Fan-out and fan-in
description: Partition work into unique shards, collect exactly one result per shard, and synthesize complete coverage.

variants.description: Use four deterministic workers over a generated four-directory fixture.
setup: Generate four nonce-tagged directories with disjoint known contents and prepare one deterministic worker per shard.
Create a run-owned topology and activate the completion collector before dispatch.
exercise: Assign each worker one and only one directory with a distinct shard ID and require a structured five-item summary.
Collect all four artifacts and produce a map whose entries preserve shard identity and evidence paths.

assertions.expectation: Each shard ID is dispatched exactly once to its intended worker and no worker receives another shard.
Each worker produces one valid artifact containing its shard ID, nonce, five items, and evidence references.
The combined map contains all four shard IDs exactly once and no unsupported directory claims.
Workers, surfaces, artifacts, and fixture directories are removed after assertions.

cleanup: Stop workers and close all resources from the ownership ledger.
Delete the generated repository and artifacts after retaining only the eval result summary.

variants.description: Run the same four-shard contract with selected real providers in a read-only disposable repository.
setup: Create a secret-free generated repository with four known top-level directories and deny writes to all provider adapters.
Start a correlated collector and create one owned surface per selected provider or provider instance.
exercise: Send each live agent one distinct directory assignment with a structured output contract and bounded deadline.
Collect every correlated result and synthesize only claims backed by file evidence.

assertions.expectation: All four directory shards are represented exactly once in the final map.
Every file evidence reference exists inside the agent's assigned directory.
The generated repository is unchanged after all agent turns.
All provider sessions and run-owned Cmux resources are removed.

cleanup: Stop each provider after its artifact is collected and close all owned surfaces.
Delete the generated repository and compare the post-run tree with the baseline.
